name: The Sisterhood of Elune
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Blessings to you, champion. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 10 to 12, 2,220 XP in all.

quests.name: The Sisterhood of Elune
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Temple of the Moon
quests.objectiveText: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.

quests.name: Tears of the Moon
quests.objectiveText: Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon at Darnassus wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets.

quests.name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
quests.objectiveText: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
